categories.name: Input data
categories.description: Optional: this capsule is mainly an environment with notebooks!! This page is for running it as a batch job for a full annotation/umap workflow.

categories.name: Output: copy in /results (default)
categories.description: Used when no external location is set below. Leave these as they are if you write to an external location.

categories.name: Output: external location (optional)
categories.description: Write the results somewhere outside the capsule instead of the copy in /results: an icechunk input's own S3 repo (one commit), or a new or existing zarr.

categories.name: Embedding
categories.description: How cells are embedded before the neighbor graph: PCA (with harmony when a batch key is given) or a newly trained scVI model.

categories.name: Neighbors, UMAP & clustering
categories.description: The neighbor graph built from the embedding, the 2-D UMAP, and Leiden clustering at one or more resolutions.

categories.name: UMAP plots
categories.description: Which UMAPs to save in /results as umap.png, one panel per name.

parameters.name: Input store
parameters.description: An AnnData .zarr, a SpatialData .zarr, or an icechunk repo in an attached data asset. EX: /data/my_asset/sample.zarr. Leave empty and a run only prints how to use the capsule.
parameters.help_text: X must hold raw counts as a sparse (CSR) matrix. The input is never changed; where the results go is set under Output.

parameters.name: SpatialData table (optional)
parameters.description: SpatialData only: the table to process, tables/<name>. Ignored for an AnnData store.

parameters.name: Icechunk branch (optional)
parameters.description: Icechunk only: the branch that is read and that the results are committed on, in the input repo, the copy in /results or the external repo. Empty means main.

parameters.name: Subset column (optional)
parameters.description: An obs column to select cells by. Leave empty to use every cell. EX: sample_id
parameters.help_text: Cells outside the subset get empty values in the results.

parameters.name: Subset values
parameters.description: Values of the subset column to keep, separated by commas. EX: SP0001, SP0002

parameters.name: Copy name (optional)
parameters.description: The copy's name in /results. Empty means <input name>.processed (.zarr for a zarr copy). An existing name is never overwritten: <name>-1, -2, ... is used.
parameters.help_text: An absolute path puts the copy there instead.

parameters.name: Copy format
parameters.description: auto: the input's own format (an icechunk copy keeps the repo's history). zarr or icechunk to convert; a SpatialData zarr can't become icechunk.

parameters.name: External location (optional)
parameters.description: Where the results go instead of /results. EX: s3://bucket/prefix
parameters.help_text: Icechunk input: its own writable S3 repo behind the data asset; the data is read from there and the results are one commit on the branch. Anything else there is refused as a likely typo. Zarr input: a new location gets a new store; an existing zarr with the same cells and genes gets the results written into it.

parameters.name: External format
parameters.description: auto: whatever is already at the location, or zarr for a new one. zarr or icechunk: what to create, and for an existing location, what it must already be (a mismatch is an error).

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: PCA: normalize, highly variable genes, scale, PCA, plus harmony when a batch key is given. scVI (train): trains a new scVI model on the raw counts of the highly variable genes; the model is saved to /results/scvi_model.
parameters.help_text: scVI's training settings (latent size, layers, epochs, batch size, ...) are SCVI_* environment variables or flags; see code/README.md.

parameters.name: Batch key (optional)
parameters.description: An obs column with the batch of each cell. PCA: harmony corrects for it. scVI: the model's batch. Several, separated by commas: harmony uses all; scVI uses the first as batch and the rest as covariates. EX: chip_id
parameters.help_text: Empty strings count as missing; cells with a missing batch make harmony and scVI fail.

parameters.name: Highly variable genes
parameters.description: How many highly variable genes the embedding uses.

parameters.name: PCA components
parameters.description: PCA only: the number of components computed (neighbors use the first 30, or all if fewer).

parameters.name: Neighbors
parameters.description: Nearest neighbors per cell in the graph.

parameters.name: UMAP min_dist
parameters.description: How tightly UMAP packs cells; smaller is tighter.

parameters.name: Leiden resolutions
parameters.description: One or more resolutions, separated by commas; higher gives more clusters. One gives obs/leiden; several give obs/leiden_<resolution> each, from one neighbor graph. Empty means 1.1. EX: 0.5, 1.0, 2.0

parameters.name: UMAP colors
parameters.description: obs columns to color the UMAP by, separated by commas. leiden stands for the cluster column(s). Names the store doesn't have are skipped. Empty means the default. EX: batch_id, chip_id, pbmc_clean_AIFI_L1_2024_label, leiden
